@@note: Content texts in English. Translator notes and the "revisar" (fact-check) notes live in es.json, the source language.
pest.gorgojo.name: Weevil
pest.gorgojo.description: Small, slow and stubborn. Dreams of tunneling through every potato in the collca.
pest.polilla.name: Moth
pest.polilla.description: Flies at night and slips through any crack. Fragile, but very fast.
pest.langosta.name: Locust
pest.langosta.description: Never comes alone: where you see one, a swarm follows.
pest.escarabajo.name: Armored Beetle
pest.escarabajo.description: Its shell shrugs off stones and pecks, but fire sends it running.
pest.espiritu_helada.name: Frost Spirit
pest.espiritu_helada.description: Comes down from the peaks on clear nights. Nothing slows it and blows pass right through it: only heat drives it away.
pest.granizo.name: Hailstone
pest.granizo.description: A grumpy chunk of ice. Break it and it splits into smaller hailstones.
pest.granizo_chico.name: Hail Pellet
pest.granizo_chico.description: The pieces of a broken hailstone. Small, quick and still eager to cause trouble.
pest.rey_gorgojo.name: Weevil King
pest.rey_gorgojo.description: The biggest, greediest weevil of all. As it marches on, it calls its court to follow.
guardian.hondero.name: Slinger
guardian.hondero.description: Whirls a sling and hurls stones nonstop. Cheap and accurate against anything that walks or flies.
guardian.hondero.branch.piedra_pesada.de: Huge stones that leave pests dazed for a moment.
guardian.hondero.branch.honda_rapida.des: Less power, but a hail of stones.
guardian.llama.name: Llama
guardian.llama.description: Spits with great aim, leaving pests sticky and slow. Little damage, but it buys time for everyone else.
guardian.llama.branch.escupitajo_pegajos: Covers a wider area and leaves pests barely moving.
guardian.llama.branch.escupitajo_certero: So strong it stuns whatever it hits.
guardian.tullpa.name: Tullpa
guardian.tullpa.description: The Andean stone hearth. Heats everything around it and burns pests that pass nearby, but can't reach the ones that fly.
guardian.tullpa.branch.fogon_grande.name: Great Hearth
guardian.tullpa.branch.fogon_grande.desc: More embers, more reach and taller flames.
guardian.tullpa.branch.brasas_eternas.de: Its fire sticks to pests and keeps burning them.
guardian.condor.name: Condor
guardian.condor.description: Watches from above and spots pests from afar. No one hunts flyers better.
guardian.condor.branch.vuelo_rasante.des: Swoops down on flyers: none escape.
Strikes slowly, but each blow pierces even the toughest shell.
guardian.pututu.name: Pututu
guardian.pututu.description: The sound of the conch calls everyone to work faster. It doesn't attack, but nearby guardians strike with more vigor.
guardian.pututu.branch.toque_de_guerra.d: A short, intense blast: less reach, much more vigor.
level.chacra_del_valle.name: Valley Fields
level.andenes.name: Terraces
level.orilla_del_lago.name: Lakeshore
